g.text: Out-of-Band Intake & Home Network Selection Request
Host JWKS Public Keys at jwks_uri
Publish Approved App Listing & Issue Active Software Statement (library_status = "active")
POST /register { software_statement, client_assertion_type, client_assertion, grant_types, scope }
Validate software_statement (Verify CMS signature, iat/exp, library_status == "active" & extract jwks_uri)
Fetch App Public JWKS from jwks_uri
Validate client_assertion & apply least-privilege scope evaluation
HTTP 201 Created { client_id, jwks_uri, grant_types, scope }
